```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
year = 2025

crash_url = paste0('https://www.planecrashinfo.com/', year, '/', year, '.htm')

crash_page <- rvest::read_html(crash_url, encoding = "ISO-8859-1")

# This should now print without the error
crash_page

# How many <table> elements are on the page?
crash_tables <- crash_page |>
  rvest::html_elements("table") |>
  rvest::html_table()

# obv, translate this into a DF
#[2] to replace the current headers with row 1 and then delete row 1 
#[3] convert date into a date 
#[4] more complex cleaning to split multiple information within a cell into a seperate column
#(outside of the scope of todys class-- feel free to try ai or regular espressiosn inf you are in 414)

#back to pepper shaker analogy
crash_df = crash_tables[[1]] #subsetting a list 

colnames(crash_df) = crash_df[1,]
crash_df = crash_df[-1,]

#convert date colum into a date type obj 
crash_df = crash_df |>
  dplyr::mutate(Date = lubridate::dmy(Date))

dplyr::glimpse(crash_df)
```

```{r in class game}
page = rvest::read_html("https://isa401-salvage.vercel.app/registry?start=1")
classes = page |>
  rvest::html_elements(".Dreadnought") |>
  rvest::html_text2()
length(classes)   # check this first: one per card

#stage 2 
base = "https://isa401-salvage.vercel.app"
starts = seq(from = 1, to = 351, by = 50)
pages = vector("list", length(starts)) 

for (i in seq_along(starts)) {
  pg = rvest::read_html(paste0(base, "/registry?start=", starts[i]))
  pages[[i]] = data.frame(
    class = pg |> rvest::html_element("div > ul > li:nth-child(1) > span") |> rvest::html_text2(),
    value = ??? |> readr::parse_number()
  )
  Sys.sleep(1)
}
registry = dplyr::bind_rows(pages)

dreadnought_df = registry |>
  dplyr::filter(class == "Dreadnought")
```
